subject.title: [Feature]: Cloud workers — run agent sessions on ephemeral SSH-reachable machines

question: Should this issue own full-session cloud workers as a distinct roadmap layer above the per-spawn backend/profile work in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/82017?
rationale: The proposals share provisioning primitives but establish different permanent session, inference, synchronization, security, and UI contracts; repository evidence cannot determine that product hierarchy without maintainer intent.

options.title: Keep distinct, share primitives
options.body: Make this the canonical full-session architecture while retaining the existing issue for subagent and ACP placement, with shared environment-provider contracts.

options.title: Merge into backend tracker
options.body: Expand the existing backend issue to own both per-spawn placement and complete remote session execution.

options.title: Move under distributed runtime
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/42026 as the umbrella and retain both narrower proposals as requirement sets until architecture approval.

recommendation.title: Keep distinct, share primitives
recommendation.body: Make this the canonical full-session architecture while retaining the existing issue for subagent and ACP placement, with shared environment-provider contracts.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored this proposal and introduced the current managed-worktree and session-target foundations it would extend.
